senses.gloss: ch. same, part. pass. כְּבִיל, f. כְּבִילָא impeded, detained.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 12:4">Targ. Koh. XII, 4</cite> <he>ריגלך כְּבִילָן וכ׳</he> thy feet are detained from going out &c. (h. text <he>סגרו</he>).

senses.gloss: same; part. pass. מְכַבַּל, f. מְכַבְּלָא tied up, (cmp. עצר) sterile.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 54a:4">Sabb. 54ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="I Kings 9:13">I Kings IX, 13</cite>, v. <cite ref="K00060">preced.</cite>; v. <cite ref="H00376"><he>חוּמְטוֹן</he></cite>) <he>ואמרו אינשי ארעא מ׳ דלא עבדא פרי</he> (Ms. O. <cite ref="M00804"><he>מְכַבַּלְתָּא</he></cite>) and people say, it is a tied up land, which bears no fruits.
